as_told.title: Lazar: Russians kicked out as ARV tensions rose

plain: Russians are said to have worked at Area 51, a secret US military test site in Nevada, in the 1980s as part of a kind of joint space program. As tensions rose over the building of ARVs, short for alien reproduction vehicles, meaning human-made craft copied from alien ones, the Russians were reportedly pushed out. Jesse Michels passes this on as a rumour from the account of Bob Lazar, a man who has told his own story about secret work at Area 51. If true, it would mean the Cold War rivals once shared their most secret work.
